title: Improve Tessera Lumen catalogue title and description
author: Jeraque007
pr_body_excerpt:
Updated Tessera Lumen catalogue listing to improve discovery and click-through.

Changes:

* Added clearer AI oracle positioning
* Replaced generic description with concise value-focused copy
* Updated category for better relevance

gist.headline: The oracle gets a signpost
gist.blurb: Tessera Lumen has traded its generic catalogue label for a clearer one. The little AI oracle is now easier to find when someone comes looking for answers in the garden.
gist.summary: Updated the Tessera Lumen catalogue listing with clearer AI-oracle positioning, concise value-focused copy, and a more relevant category to improve discovery.
gist.impact: People browsing the app catalogue can more readily understand what Tessera Lumen does and find it in the right place.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Tessera Lumen as a cozy glowing pixel oracle card or crystal display receiving a freshly painted garden signpost. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses and holding a paintbrush, updates the sign while flowers and code-plants surround the catalogue shelf; the scene represents clearer naming, description, and categorization.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and tiny librarian glasses, painting a clear signpost beside a glowing AI oracle card on a retro catalogue shelf; little flowers and code-plants bloom around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with small pixel-font text: 'AI ORACLE'.
